knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

##Libraries

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)

```


##Load the data

```{r}

trial_data <- read.csv(
  "C:/Users/39351/github/clinical-Trial-Biostatistics/data/simulated/clinical_trial_data.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

```


## Number of participants in each group

```{r}

table(trial_data$treatment)

```


## Mean age by treatment group

```{r}
aggregate(
  age ~ treatment,
  data = trial_data,
  FUN = mean
)


ggplot(trial_data, aes(x = treatment, y = age, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Age distribution by treatment group",
    x = "Treatment group",
    y = "Age (years)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```

## Gender by treatment group

```{r}

table(trial_data$treatment, trial_data$sex)


ggplot(trial_data, aes(x = treatment, fill = sex)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(
    title = "Sex distribution by treatment group",
    x = "Treatment group",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


## Baseline LDL by treatment group

```{r}

aggregate(
  baseline_ldl ~ treatment,
  data = trial_data,
  FUN = mean
)


ggplot(trial_data, aes(
  x = treatment,
  y = baseline_ldl,
  fill = treatment
)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Baseline LDL cholesterol by treatment group",
    x = "Treatment group",
    y = "Baseline LDL (mg/dL)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```



## Week-12 LDL by treatment group

```{r}

aggregate(
  week12_ldl ~ treatment,
  data = trial_data,
  FUN = mean
)


## compare baseline LDL with Week-12 LDL
ggplot(trial_data, aes(
  x = baseline_ldl,
  y = week12_ldl,
  color = treatment
)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Baseline and week-12 LDL cholesterol",
    x = "Baseline LDL (mg/dL)",
    y = "Week-12 LDL (mg/dL)",
    color = "Treatment group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()



```



## Mean LDL reduction by treatment group

```{r}

aggregate(
  ldl_reduction ~ treatment,
  data = trial_data,
  FUN = mean
)


ggplot(trial_data, aes(
  x = treatment,
  y = ldl_reduction,
  fill = treatment
)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, show.legend = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "LDL cholesterol reduction at week 12",
    x = "Treatment group",
    y = "LDL reduction (mg/dL)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```



## Standard deviation of LDL reduction

```{r}

aggregate(
  ldl_reduction ~ treatment,
  data = trial_data,
  FUN = sd
)

```


## Adverse event proportions


```{r}

aggregate(
  adverse_event ~ treatment,
  data = trial_data,
  FUN = mean
)


adverse_summary <- trial_data %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    participants = n(),
    events = sum(adverse_event),
    event_proportion = mean(adverse_event),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(adverse_summary, aes(
  x = treatment,
  y = event_proportion,
  fill = treatment
)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Adverse events by treatment group",
    x = "Treatment group",
    y = "Participants with an adverse event"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


```
